['Bechtle AG '].company_description: Bechtle AG is a multinational technology company with a business model combining information technology services with the direct sale of hardware and software IT products, as well as the operation and maintenance of IT infrastructure for industrial customers and public-sector clients. The Bechtle Group is headquartered in Neckarsulm, Baden-Württemberg, and organised into multiple parent and holding companies. The company has 70 locations in german-speaking regions and trading companies in 14 European countries. A survey conducted by German industry publications ranks Bechtle as the largest business-to-business IT service provider by revenue in Germany in 2018.

['Lufthansa City Center International Gm.company_description: Lufthansa City Center International GmbH operates as the world's largest independent franchise company in the travel agency market, with around 500 offices in 90 countries and total sales of around 5.4 billion euros (fiscal year 2019). The company is active in the leisure (tourism) and corporate (business travel) sectors.
